intent: A single radio option, as a classic circular control or a pill-shaped toggle button.
use_when: One option within a mutually-exclusive set.
dont_use_when: Independent on/off — use a checkbox / switch.
A connected row of options — use SegmentedControl.

tokens.note: Fully token-bound: the button variant's active/selected ring binds to --color-border-selected-subtle, and every other fill, text, and border resolves to a DS token.

a11y.state: aria-checked reflects selection; aria-disabled when disabled.
a11y.grouping: the host wraps peers in a radiogroup and owns arrow-key selection.
